masked_prior_rectangle.scope: Y=G*op(P,D)+(prior & L), P=A*b+a_shr19 modulo2^32; A/G/L/D root-only arbitrary uint32, D nonzero, op floor/ceil/REM.
masked_prior_rectangle.proof: Even G fails the b^65536 bit0 witness. For odd G put B=G^-1. The rectangle has Delta(prior & L)=0 for EVERY L and Delta(P)=0 for EVERY A. Thus Delta(q)=B*Delta(Y)=2^31. For floor/ceil D>=5 the quotient range bounds the circular distance by2*ceil(MASK/5)<2^31. For D1/3, D*Delta(q)=2^31 cannot be a mixed remainder difference bounded by2*(D-1). D2/4 cannot transmit b16 to bit0: numerator low16 and all initial low16 are fixed, and quotient bit0 depends only on numerator low2/low3. REM is bounded by the478-state divisor limit and has the same range contradiction.
